privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: List Mango is designed with privacy in mind. Your lists are stored securely and are only accessible via their unique URLs. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising purposes.
privacy.note: Note: All lists are public URLs. Never share personal information in a list.

publicUse.title: Public Use and Sharing
publicUse.content: List Mango checklists are inherently public. Once you create a list and share its link, anyone with access to that link can view and edit the list. Since lists are designed to be shared freely, we strongly advise against using List Mango to store or transmit sensitive, confidential, or any personal information that you do not wish to make public.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection and Use
dataCollection.content: As of now, List Mango does not require user registration, which means we do not collect personal data such as names, email addresses, or any other contact information. All lists are created anonymously.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.content: We utilize Google Analytics to analyze the performance of List Mango, which helps us understand traffic patterns and user engagement in an anonymous form. Google Analytics may collect non-personally identifiable information such as your device type, browser type, and the way you interact with List Mango. This data is used strictly for the purpose of enhancing user experience and improving our service.

contact.title: Contact Information
contact.content: Should you have any questions about this privacy policy or List Mango's practices, please feel free to reach out to us at

sections.changes: Please be aware that our Privacy Policy may change from time to time. We will not reduce your rights under this Privacy Policy without providing notice, and we expect most such changes will be minor.
